scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Welcome to the
Monster Race Arena.
If you'd like to participate
in the ^3131FFSingle Monster Race^000000,
then please select 1 out of
the 6 monsters from the list.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
欢迎来到魔物赛跑竞技场。
如果您想参加^3131FF单魔物赛跑^000000，
请从列表中6只魔物里选择1只。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Wait, wait...
I can't give you
anything right now.
You're carrying way
too many things...
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
等等，等等...
我现在什么都给不了您。
您携带的东西太多了...

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
You have selected
Monster ^FF0000{0}^000000 for the
Single Monster Race.
The start of the race
will be announced soon,
so please wait. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
您已选择魔物^FF0000{0}^000000参加单魔物赛跑。
比赛即将开始，请等待。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
You've chosen Monster {0}?
Alright then, please wait
until the start of the race is
announced. If the monster you
picked wins, then please use this ticket to redeem your prize.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
您选择了魔物{0}？
好的，请等待比赛开始的通知。
如果您选择的魔物获胜，请凭此票兑换奖品。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
I'm sorry, but a Monster
Race is now in progress.
If you'd like to participate, then please wait for the next race.
scripts.translation:
[票务助手]
很抱歉，魔物赛跑正在进行中。
如果您想参加，请等待下一场比赛。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
I'm sorry, but I can't
reward you with any medals
until you make more space
available in your Inventory.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
很抱歉，在您的物品栏腾出更多空间之前，
我无法向您发放任何奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Hello there~
If you've wagered on the
winning monster in a recent
race, then you can exchange
your game ticket here for
some Prize Medals.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
您好~
如果您在最近一场比赛中押中了获胜的魔物，
可以在此将您的比赛门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Please remember that you can
only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
请记住，您只能在比赛结束后立即
将获胜的比赛门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。
神奇的奖牌可以交给毁葛的韦恩兑换物品。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Oh, congratulations, you
have a winning ticket for
a Single Monster Race! So 
would you like to exchange your
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
哦，恭喜您，您有一张单魔物赛跑的获胜门票！
那么，您想将您的赛跑门票兑换为神奇的奖牌吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Um, are you sure? You 
can only exchange a winning
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals
for a short time after the race. If you made a mistake, you
should ask me again quickly.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
嗯，您确定吗？
您只能在比赛结束后的一小段时间内
将获胜的赛跑门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。
如果您选错了，请尽快再次向我询问。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Let me see your ticket...
Oh! Congratulations, you
won! May I have your name?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
让我看看您的门票...
哦！恭喜您，您赢了！
请问您的名字是？

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Ah, {0}.
You can exchange this
ticket for a Prize Medal by
entering your ticket exchange
number now. Your ticket
exchange number is ^FF0000{1}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
啊，{0}。
您现在可以输入您的门票兑换号码
将此门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。
您的门票兑换号码是^FF0000{1}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Oh? You don't want
to exchange your
winning ticket?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
哦？您不想兑换
您的获胜门票吗？

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Thank you! You entered
the correct number...
Everything seems to
be in order. Alright!
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
谢谢！您输入的号码是正确的...
一切看起来都没问题。好的！

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Now please accept your
Prize Medals! You can
exchange these with
Wayne in Hugel for some
interesting items. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
请收下您的神奇的奖牌！
您可以拿着这些奖牌去找毁葛的韦恩
兑换一些有趣的物品。谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
I'm sorry, but it seems
that you entered the
incorrect ticket number.
Would you mind coming
back again in a while?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
很抱歉，看来您输入的门票号码有误。
您介意稍后再来一次吗？

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
What's this...?
I think there's a problem...
Did you enter your name
incorrectly? Please check
your name, and then try again.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
这是什么...？
我觉得有点问题...
您是不是名字输入错了？
请检查一下您的名字，然后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
You may not have wagered
on the winning monster in
the last race, but I hope that
you get lucky next time~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
您可能没有押中上一场比赛的获胜魔物，
但我希望您下次能好运~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Hello there~
If you've wagered on the
winning monster in a recent
race, then you can exchange
your game ticket here for
some Prize Medals.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
您好~
如果您在最近一场比赛中押中了获胜的魔物，
可以在此将您的比赛门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Please remember that you can
only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
请记住，您只能在比赛结束后立即
将获胜的比赛门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。
神奇的奖牌可以交给毁葛的韦恩兑换物品。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you have a winning Racing
Ticket, please make sure that
you redeem it for Prize Medals
now. All Racing Tickets become
void once the next race begins.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
如果您有获胜的赛跑门票，
请务必现在将其兑换为神奇的奖牌。
下一场比赛开始后，所有赛跑门票都将失效。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you wish to leave
the arena, then I can guide
you outside. Would you like
to leave the arena right now?
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
如果您想离开竞技场，
我可以为您指引出口。
您现在想离开竞技场吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Alright, then.
Just let me know
whenever you're
ready to leave.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
好的。
当您准备好离开时，
请随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Thank you for
your patronage, and
I hope that you come
visit us again soon~
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
感谢您的惠顾，
希望您很快能再来~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
In accordance with our
policies, I must take your
Racing Ticket before you leave.
Thank you for your patronage,
and I hope you enjoy your time
here in the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
根据我们的规定，
在您离开之前，我必须收回您的赛跑门票。
感谢您的惠顾，
希望您在这里享受魔物赛跑竞技场的时光。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Welcome to the biggest
attraction in Hugel, the
Monster Race Arena.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
欢迎来到毁葛最大的景点，
魔物赛跑竞技场。
今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Monster Race Info
scripts.translation: 魔物赛跑信息

scripts.text: Enter Monster Race
scripts.translation: 进入魔物赛跑

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Monster Races originated from
simple children's games in which
Cute Pets would race against each other. This grew into an adult
pastime that is so popular, we've built a racing arena in Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
魔物赛跑起源于孩子们简单的游戏，
可爱的宠物们互相赛跑。
这逐渐发展成为一种成人的娱乐活动，
非常受欢迎，以至于我们在毁葛建造了一个赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Our Monster Race Arena hosts
two types of monster races. First, we have the Single Monster Race,
in which those that wagered on the 1st place monster are rewarded.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
我们的魔物赛跑竞技场举办两种类型的魔物赛跑。
首先是单魔物赛跑，押中第一名魔物的人将获得奖励。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Then, we have the Dual Monster
Race in which the house odds and rewards are greater than in Single
Monster Races: you must wager on 2 monsters, and they must place in
1st and 2nd for you to win.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
然后是双魔物赛跑，
其赔率和奖励比单魔物赛跑更高：
您必须押注两只魔物，
且它们必须分别获得第一名和第二名您才能获胜。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Although a small entrance
fee is required, we only use
the money to give rewards to
participants and maintain this
arena. Therefore, we're not
profiting from this enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
虽然需要支付少量的入场费，
但我们只使用这笔钱来奖励参与者
并维护这个竞技场。
因此，我们并没有从中获利。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Also, we prohibit others
from making personal bets
and wagers, using items and
zeny, based on the outcomes
of these races. That kind of
gambling is illegal here...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
此外，我们禁止他人
使用物品和Zeny，
基于这些比赛的结果进行个人押注和赌博。
这种赌博在这里是非法的...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Once you enter the Race Arena, you will receive a Racing Ticket.
Keep in mind that winning Racing Tickets can only be exchanged for
Prize Medals during a 5 minute window after the end of the race.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
一旦您进入赛跑竞技场，您将获得一张赛跑门票。
请记住，获胜的赛跑门票只能在比赛结束后的5分钟窗口期内兑换为神奇的奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
The entrance fee for all races
in the Monster Race Arena is
2,000 zeny. If you'd like to wager on a Dual Monster Race, then
please ask my brother Erenes,
and he will help you.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
魔物赛跑竞技场所有比赛的入场费均为2,000 Zeny。
如果您想押注双魔物赛跑，
请找我的兄弟埃雷内斯，他会协助您。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Otherwise, I'll help get you
started if you're interested
in a Single Monster Race.
Would you like wager on
a Single Monster Race?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
否则，如果您有兴趣参加单魔物赛跑，
我可以帮您开始。
您想押注单魔物赛跑吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Very well. I hope that
you enjoy your time here
in the Monster Race Arena~
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
好的。希望您
在魔物赛跑竞技场玩得尽兴~

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Oh, wow. You're carrying
an awful lot of stuff... Yeah,
you better put some of it away
in Kafra Storage or something.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
哦，天哪。您身上带的东西
可真不少... 是的，
您最好把一些东西存到卡普拉仓库里。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
money to pay the
2,000 zeny entrance fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法支付2,000 Zeny的入场费。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Hm? What are you doing
with an expired Racing Ticket?
Well, I better get rid of it for you before it can get mixed up
with your new Racing Ticket.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
嗯？您拿着过期的赛跑门票做什么？
好吧，我最好帮您把它处理掉，
以免它和您新的赛跑门票混在一起。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
money to pay the
2,000 zeny entrance fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法支付2,000 Zeny的入场费。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Alright, I think you
should be all set. I hope
that you enjoy the race~
Let me guide you inside
the Monster Race Arena now.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
好的，我想您
已经准备就绪了。希望您
享受这场赛跑~
现在让我带您进入魔物赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Thanks, I hope that
you enjoy this race.
Let me guide you now
to the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
谢谢，希望您
享受这场赛跑。
现在让我带您
前往魔物赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
We're still finishing our
preparations for the next
Single Monster Race, so
we ask that you please
wait a little while longer...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
我们还在为下一场
单魔物赛跑做最后的准备，
所以请您稍等片刻...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Right now, a Monster Race
is in progress. It's too late to place a wager, but if you'd like
to watch, the fee is 500 zeny
for spectators. Would you like to enter the Monster Race Arena?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
目前，一场魔物赛跑正在进行中。现在押注已经太晚了，但如果您想观看，观众费是500 Zeny。
您想进入魔物赛跑竞技场吗？

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Alright, then. If you'd like
to wager on a monster
race, please wait for the
current race to finish. I hope
that you enjoy your time here
in the Monster Race Arena~
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
好的。如果您想
押注魔物赛跑，请等待
当前比赛结束。希望您
在魔物赛跑竞技场玩得尽兴~

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Thank you~
I hope you enjoy
watching this race!
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
谢谢~
希望您享受
观看这场赛跑！

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough money to pay
the 500 zeny spectator fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法支付500 Zeny的观众费。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but a monster
race has just ended, so we're
having the 5 minute period in
which the winners can claim
their Prize Medals. The gate
will open soon, so please wait.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾勒伯德]
很抱歉，一场魔物赛跑刚刚结束，
现在是5分钟的窗口期，
获胜者可以领取他们的神奇的奖牌。大门
很快就会打开，请稍候。

scripts.text:
[Game Guide]
Welcome to the
Monster Race Arena.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[游戏向导]
欢迎来到
魔物赛跑竞技场。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Monster Race Info
scripts.translation: 魔物赛跑信息

scripts.text: Wager Info
scripts.translation: 押注信息

scripts.translation: 门票兑换信息

scripts.text:
[Game Guide]
Before placing a wager, you
must get a free Racing Ticket
from the Ticket Helper. There,
I've marked the Ticket Helper
on your Mini-Map, so you can
find him pretty easily.
scripts.translation:
[游戏向导]
在押注之前，您必须从票务助手那里领取一张免费的赛跑门票。我已经在您的小地图上标记了票务助手的位置，您应该很容易找到他。

scripts.text:
[Game Guide]
If you wagered on the winner
of a Single Monster Race, or
on the 1st or 2nd place winners
in a Dual Monster Race, then
you can exchange your Racing
Ticket for Prize Medals.
scripts.translation:
[游戏向导]

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Monster Races originated from
simple children's games in which
Cute Pets would race against each other. This grew into an adult
pastime that is so popular, we've built a racing arena in Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
魔物赛跑起源于孩子们简单的游戏，可爱的宠物互相赛跑。这逐渐发展成一种成人的娱乐活动，非常受欢迎，我们在毁葛建造了一个赛跑竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Our Monster Race Arena hosts
two types of monster races. First, we have the Single Monster Race,
in which those that wagered on the 1st place monster are rewarded.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
我们的魔物赛跑竞技场举办两种类型的魔物赛跑。首先，我们有单魔物赛跑，押中第一名魔物的人将获得奖励。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Then, we have the Dual Monster
Race in which the house odds and rewards are greater than in Single
Monster Races: you must wager on 2 monsters, and they must place in
1st and 2nd for you to win.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
然后，我们有双魔物赛跑，其赔率和奖励比单魔物赛跑更高：您必须押注两只魔物，且它们必须分别获得第一名和第二名您才能获胜。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Although a small entrance
fee is required, we only use
the money to give rewards to
participants and maintain this
arena. Therefore, we're not
profiting from this enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
虽然需要缴纳少量的入场费，但我们只将这些钱用于奖励参赛者和维护竞技场。因此，我们并没有从中牟利。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Also, we prohibit others
from making personal bets
and wagers, using items and
zeny, based on the outcomes
of these races. That kind of
gambling is illegal here...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]
此外，我们禁止他人基于比赛结果，使用物品或Zeny进行私人押注。这种行为在这里是违法的...

[Eckar Erenes]

Prize Medals during a 5 minute window after the end of the race.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡尔·艾雷内斯]

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]

in the Monster Race Arena is
2,000 zeny. If you'd like to wager on a Single Monster Race,
then please ask my brother
Ellebird to help you.

started if you're interested
in a Dual Monster Race.
Would you like to wager
on a Dual Monster Race?

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]
Very well. I hope that
you enjoy your time here
in the Monster Race Arena~
scripts.translation:

好的。希望您能在魔物赛跑竞技场度过愉快的时光~

preparations for the next

wait a little while longer...

scripts.text:

you enjoy this race.

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

谢谢~
希望您能享受观看这场赛跑！

scripts.text:
[Eckar Erenes]

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

选择您认为会获得第1名或第2名的魔物。

您押注了
^0000FF魔物 {0}^000000 和 ^0000FF魔物 {1}^000000

scripts.translation:

您为这场双魔物赛跑

However, you must exchange
your Racing Ticket with the
Medal Distributor within the
5 minute window after the end
of the race. ^FF0000Your ticket becomes^FFFFFF ^FF0000 void after these 5 minutes.^000000
scripts.translation:
[游戏向导]
但是，您必须在比赛结束后的5分钟内，找勋章发放员兑换您的赛跑门票。^FF0000您的门票在这5分钟后将^FFFFFF ^FF0000失效。^000000

scripts.text:
[Game Guide]
When this 5 minute window
elapses, you will be teleported outside, and we will immediately
begin preparing for the next race. Make sure that you remember this
information when you wager.
scripts.translation:
[游戏向导]
当这5分钟的时间过去后，您将被传送出去，我们将立即开始准备下一场比赛。请在押注时务必记住这一信息。

scripts.text:
[Game Guide]
If you haven't received
your free Racing Ticket,
then please visit the Ticket
Helper. There, I've just marked
his location on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[游戏向导]
如果您还没有领取免费的赛跑门票，请前往票务助手处。我刚刚在他的位置标记了您的小地图。

scripts.text:
[Game Guide]
Thank you, and
I hope you enjoy
your time here in the
Monster Racing Arena.
scripts.translation:
[游戏向导]
谢谢，希望您能在魔物赛跑竞技场度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
I'm sorry, but I can't
reward you with any medals
until you make more space
available in your Inventory.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
很抱歉，在您的物品栏腾出更多空间之前，
我无法向您发放任何奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Hello there~
If you've wagered on the
winning monster in a recent
race, then you can exchange
your game ticket here for
some Prize Medals.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
您好~
如果您在最近一场比赛中押中了获胜的魔物，
可以在此将您的比赛门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Please remember that you can
only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
请记住，您只能在比赛结束后立即
将获胜的比赛门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。
神奇的奖牌可以交给毁葛的韦恩兑换物品。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Please remember that you can
only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
请记住，您只能在比赛结束后立即
将获胜的比赛门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。
神奇的奖牌可以交给毁葛的韦恩兑换物品。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Congratulations! It's really
difficult to guess the winners
of a Dual Monster Race, so you
must be really lucky! Would you
like to exchange your winning
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals?
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
恭喜！猜中双魔物赛跑的
获胜者真的很难，
您一定非常幸运！您想
将获胜的赛跑门票兑换为神奇的奖牌吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Okay, everything looks good,
so here's your Prize Medals~
If you want to trade these
medals for items, please
visit Wayne in Hugel. We hope
you enjoyed the Monster Race~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
好的，一切看起来都没问题，
这是您的神奇的奖牌~
如果您想将这些奖牌
兑换为物品，请前往毁葛找韦恩。希望您
享受了魔物赛跑~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Um, are you sure? You 
can only exchange a winning
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals
for a short time after the race. If you made a mistake, you
should ask me again quickly.
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
嗯，您确定吗？
您只能在比赛结束后的一小段时间内
将获胜的赛跑门票兑换为神奇的奖牌。
如果您选错了，请尽快再次向我询问。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Well, better luck next time...
Although you can't always
be lucky, it's always fun to
wager on the monster races!
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
嗯，下次好运吧...
虽然不可能总是幸运，
但在魔物赛跑上下注总是很有趣的！

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Thanks for visiting the
Monster Race Arena, and
I hope you enjoy your time
here. I'll see you next time~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
感谢您光临魔物赛跑竞技场，
希望您在这里度过愉快的时光。
下次再见~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
You may not have wagered
on the winning monster in
the last race, but I hope that
you get lucky next time~
scripts.translation:
[勋章发放员]
您可能没有押中上一场比赛的获胜魔物，
但我希望您下次能好运~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you have a winning Racing
Ticket, please make sure that
you redeem it for Prize Medals
now. All Racing Tickets become
void once the next race begins.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
如果您有获胜的赛跑门票，
请务必现在将其兑换为神奇的奖牌。
下一场比赛开始后，所有赛跑门票都将失效。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you wish to leave
the arena, then I can guide
you outside. Would you like
to leave the arena right now?
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
如果您想离开竞技场，
我可以为您指引出口。
您现在想离开竞技场吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Alright, then.
Just let me know
whenever you're
ready to leave.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
好的。
当您准备好离开时，
请随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Thank you for
your patronage, and
I hope that you come
visit us again soon~
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
感谢您的惠顾，
希望您很快能再来~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
In accordance with our
policies, I must take your
Racing Ticket before you leave.
Thank you for your patronage,
and I hope you enjoy your time
here in the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[出口向导]
根据我们的规定，
在您离开之前，我必须收回您的赛跑门票。
感谢您的惠顾，
希望您在这里享受魔物赛跑竞技场的时光。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Curses! We need to deliver
what our customers ordered,
but we've been making nothing
but shipshod products! If we
only had that metal, we could
pump up our product quality!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
该死！我们需要交付
顾客订购的产品，
但我们一直在生产劣质品！如果我们有那种金属，
我们就能提高产品质量！

scripts.text: What metal are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你说的是哪种金属？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
There's a small village
at the outskirts of the
Schwarzwald Republic that
gives these special medals
that are made of this metal
which we desperately need...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的边缘
有一个小村庄，那里会发放
由我们急需的这种金属制成的
特殊奖牌...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
We've sent one of our best
guildsmen to get some of those
medals for us, but he hasn't
reported back to us quite yet.
I'm getting pretty anxious...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
我们已经派了我们公会
最好的成员之一去为我们
获取一些那些奖牌，但他还没有
向我们汇报。我有点着急了...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I mean, we need a whole
lot of that metal to fill out
our orders and finish our
manufacturing research,
but so far, none of us have
been able to get any medals...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
我的意思是，我们需要大量的那种金属
来完成订单并结束我们的
制造研究，
但到目前为止，我们还没有人
能够获取到任何奖牌...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Are you talking
about the medals that
they give as rewards in
the Monster Race Arena?
I have some of those.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！您说的是魔物赛跑竞技场
作为奖励发放的那些奖牌吗？
我正好有一些。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Huh? Show them to me...
Yes! That's exactly what
we need! Would you please
donate your medals so that we
can finally make some quality
products for our customers?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
咦？给我看看...
没错！正是我们需要的那个！
您愿意捐赠这些奖牌，
让我们终于能为顾客
生产高质量的产品吗？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you happen to obtain any
medals from the Monster
Race Arena in Hugel, then
please bring some of them
to me. I'll be sure to repay
you for your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果您在毁葛的魔物赛跑竞技场
获得了奖牌，
请带一些给我。
我一定会报答您的好意...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, how have you been?
Thank you so much for
donating so many medals,
they've been helpful in my
research. Still, I need more
and more of them everyday...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
哦，最近怎么样？
非常感谢您捐赠了这么多奖牌，
它们对我的研究很有帮助。
不过，我每天都还需要更多...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
The other Blacksmith
Guildsmen are doing their
best to collect Prize Medals
in Hugel, but they keep failing
to win them! If you have any
medals, then may I have some?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
其他铁匠公会的成员
正在努力收集毁葛的神奇奖牌，
但他们一直没能赢到！
如果您有奖牌的话，
能给我一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you happen to obtain any
medals from the Monster
Race Arena in Hugel, then
please bring some of them
to me. I'll be sure to repay
you for your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果您在毁葛的魔物赛跑竞技场
获得了奖牌，
请带一些给我。
我一定会报答您的好意...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Goodness, you're carrying
so many things with you!
You'd better put some of
it away in Kafra Storage
before you're overwhelmed
by the bulk of your items!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
天哪，您身上带了这么多东西！
最好把一些放进卡普拉仓库，
以免被过多的物品压垮！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, welcome back! I've finally
made a breakthrough in my
metal research! Look, I've
developed this Glittering
Jacket! It's lightweight and
very durable, you see?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
啊，欢迎回来！
我的金属研究终于取得了突破！
看，我开发了这件秘衣 恶德！
它很轻便，而且非常耐用，您看？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I wouldn't be able to have
completed this without your
help. Now, would you like to
receive this Glittering Jacket
as my way of repaying you?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果没有您的帮助，
我是不可能完成的。
现在，您愿意接受这件秘衣 恶德
作为我对您的回报吗？

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Wait for Further Development
scripts.translation: 等待进一步开发

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, I see. You'd rather wait
until we develop something
more to your liking. In that
case, would you please donate
more medals to my research?
We're always low on them...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
啊，我明白了。您宁愿等到
我们开发出更符合您心意的东西。
既然如此，您愿意再捐赠一些奖牌
给我的研究吗？
我们总是很缺...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, you're back!
Thanks to all the medals
that you've donated, I'm now
able to manufacture a set
of slotted armor imbued
with a property of your choice.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
哦，您回来了！
多亏您捐赠的所有奖牌，
我现在能够制造一套
带有您所选属性的插槽防具了。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you'd like, I can repay you
now by creating a set of slotted elemental armor for you, or we
can wait for you to donate more
medals until I can develop
something else for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果您愿意，我现在就可以为您
打造一套插槽元素防具作为回报，
或者我们可以等您捐赠更多奖牌，
直到我能为您开发其他东西。

scripts.text: Accept Armor
scripts.translation: 接受防具

scripts.text: Can I have something else?
scripts.translation: 我能要别的东西吗？

scripts.text: Wait for Further Development
scripts.translation: 等待进一步开发

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I can manufacture one set of
slotted Armor imbued with the
Fire, Earth, Wind, or Water
property. Which property would
you like your armor to have?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
我可以制造一套带有火、地、风
或水属性的插槽防具。
您希望您的防具具有哪种属性？

scripts.text: Fire Property
scripts.translation: 火属性

scripts.text: Earth Property
scripts.translation: 土属性

scripts.text: Wind Property
scripts.translation: 风属性

scripts.text: Water Property
scripts.translation: 水属性

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Something else...?
Oh, you must mean
the Glittering Jacket that
I developed earlier. After
all, I have any other items
to offer you for now...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
别的东西...？
哦，您指的应该是
我之前开发的那件秘衣 恶德。
毕竟，我现在没有其他物品
可以提供给您了...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, I see. You'd rather wait
until we develop something
more to your liking. In that
case, would you please donate
more medals to my research?
We're always low on them...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
啊，我明白了。您宁愿等到
我们开发出更符合您心意的东西。
既然如此，您愿意再捐赠一些奖牌
给我的研究吗？
我们总是很缺...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
The other Blacksmith
Guildsmen are doing their
best to collect Prize Medals
in Hugel, but they keep failing
to win them! If you have any
medals, then may I have some?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
其他铁匠公会的成员
正在努力收集毁葛的神奇奖牌，
但他们一直没能赢到！
如果您有奖牌的话，
能给我一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you happen to obtain any
medals from the Monster
Race Arena in Hugel, then
please bring some of them
to me. I'll be sure to repay
you for your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果您在毁葛的魔物赛跑竞技场
获得了奖牌，
请带一些给我。
我一定会报答您的好意...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, you're back! I've
extracted all the metal
from the medals you've
given me, and I think I have
enough to create a Level 4
Weapon. Isn't that incredible?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
啊，您回来了！
我已经从您给我的奖牌中
提取了所有金属，
我想我有足够的材料
来制作一把4级武器了。
这不可思议吗？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you like, I can create
one of these weapons for you
as my way of repaying you for
your help. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
如果您愿意，我可以为您打造
其中一把武器，作为对您帮助的回报。
您觉得如何？

scripts.text: Yes, I want a Level 4 Weapon.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想要一把4级武器。

scripts.text: Can I have something else?
scripts.translation: 我能要别的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Something else?
Oh, alright then, would
you like to have a Glittering
Jacket, or a set of slotted
elemental Armor? Please go
ahead and make your choice~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
别的东西？
哦，好吧，那您想要一件秘衣 恶德，
还是一套插槽元素防具？
请随意选择~

scripts.text: Glittering Jacket
scripts.translation: 秘衣 恶德

scripts.text: Fire Property Armor
scripts.translation: 火属性防具

scripts.text: Earth Property Armor
scripts.translation: 土属性防具

scripts.text: Wind Property Armor
scripts.translation: 风属性防具

scripts.text: Water Property Armor
scripts.translation: 水属性防具

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
So you'd like to have a
{0}? Please choose
which Level 4 Weapon
that you want me to create.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
您想要{0}吗？
请告诉我您想让我打造哪一把4级武器。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, alright...
Still, I really need
those medals, so if you
change your mind, please
come back as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
哦，好吧...
不过我真的很需要那些奖牌，
如果您改变主意了，
请尽快回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, thank you so much!
I can use the metal in those
medals to produce some high
quality products. Now, how
shall I repay you for giving me
some of your Prize Medals?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
哦，太感谢您了！
我可以用那些奖牌里的金属
制造出高品质的产品。
那么，我该如何回报
您给我的神奇奖牌呢？

scripts.text: Base Experience
scripts.translation: 基础经验值

scripts.text: Job Experience
scripts.translation: 职业经验值

scripts.text: No, I'm just glad to help.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是很高兴能帮上忙。

scripts.text: How's your research progressing?
scripts.translation: 您的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
You just want to improve
yourself, huh? Well, I dunno
if you want to get stronger,
smarter, or faster, but I can
coach you on some visualization if you like. Now, relax with me~
physical development.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
您只是想让自己变得更强，对吧？
嗯，我不知道您是想变强、变聪明还是变快，
但如果您愿意，我可以教您一些意象训练。
现在，跟着我一起放松~
进行身体开发。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Focus... and believe.
Believe that you are
becoming what you want
to be! B-believe... with
all of your freakin' heart!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
集中注意力...并去相信。
相信您正在成为您想成为的样子！
相...相信...用您全部的心去相信！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
*Phew* How's that?
Now do you see the
power of hope?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
*呼* 感觉如何？
现在您看到希望的力量了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
You want to become more
competent in your job? Um...
Alright, we can do that. Just
meditate with me, and we'll go
do some imagery work together.
I'm real good at this you know.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
您想在工作中变得更胜任吗？嗯...
好吧，我们可以做到。只需跟着我冥想，
我们一起做一些意象工作。
我在这方面真的很擅长，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
J-just... visualize
yourself... being...
t-totally... awesome!
You've gotta see it, and
you've gotta feel it in your
freakin' heart and mind!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
只...只要...想象...自己...
完...完全...很厉害！
您必须看到它，
并且必须用您的心和头脑去感受它！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Yeap, it doesn't matter
if it's real or imagined...
Your mind will work on
whatever you feed it.
Placebos and psychosomatic symptoms-- it all ties together.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲尔]
是的，无论是真实的还是想象的...
您的大脑会处理您输入的任何东西。
安慰剂效应和心身症状——它们都是相互关联的。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
What th--?! You sure
you don't want anything?
Hm, well, I think it's kind
of bad karma if I don't give
you anything in return, so...
Think of something. Quick.
scripts.translation:

to the Blacksmith Guild...

在魔物赛跑竞技场赢来的那些神奇的奖牌能用来做什么？

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
...Or you can exchange them
for items, right here and right
now, with me. As always, the
choice is really up to you.

选择权完全在您。

village on the outskirts of

map until they opened up
their Monster Race Arena!

在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的边缘，
有一个古老而谦逊的村庄。
直到他们开放了魔物赛跑竞技场，
它才在地图上变得引人注目！

scripts.text:
[Eocatt]
If you win wagers on the
monster race games, you'll
be rewarded with these Prize
Medals that are made of some
really rare metal. I hear this metal's in demand in Einbroch...
scripts.translation:
[埃奥卡特]
如果你在魔物赛跑中赢得赌注，
就会获得这些由极其稀有的金属制成的神奇的奖牌。
我听说这种金属在艾音布罗克很抢手...

scripts.text:
[Eocatt]
Right, right...
I remember now, the
town was named Hugel.
I'm sure there's other fun
things to do there, but I'm sure that the Race Arena is a must!
scripts.translation:
[埃奥卡特]
没错，没错...
我想起来了，那个城镇叫毁葛。
我相信那里还有其他有趣的事情，
但竞技场绝对是必去之地！

scripts.text:
[Mudie]
The Monster Races
are probably the biggest
attraction here in Hugel.
We don't have much else
going on here, I'm afraid.
scripts.translation:
[穆迪]
魔物赛跑大概是这里毁葛最大的看点。
恐怕我们这里没什么其他活动了。

[Mudie]
If you want to go visit
the Monster Race Arena,
just head towards the
7 'o clock direction on
your Mini-Map, and look for
the hill surrounded by a fence.
scripts.translation:
[穆迪]
如果你想参观魔物赛跑竞技场，
只需朝小地图的7点钟方向走，
寻找那个被围栏围住的小山丘。

somewhere around that area.

or just watch the races, just
ask one of the Eckar brothers. I hope you enjoy our little town~

luck in wagering history!

with some rare metal, but...

I need to win some
medals! Otherwise, I'll
be too ashamed to return
home to Einbroch! F-faster!

我会羞愧得不敢回到艾音布罗克！快...再快点！

would you share it with me?

I really wanna win more!

bet on the black Deviruchi~

I can't go back until I get
at least one Prize Medal!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
这怎么可能这么难？
为什么我连一场比赛都赢不了？啊！
在拿到至少一枚神奇的奖牌之前，我不能回去！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Yeah, I've been assigned
by the Einbroch Factory to
get some Prize Medals since
they're made of this rare medal. But it looks like they picked
the wrong guy for this job...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
是的，艾音布罗克工厂派我来拿一些神奇的奖牌，
因为它们是用这种稀有金属制成的。但看起来他们选错人了...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
I mean, I've been here
forever and I haven't won
anything yet! Hey, do me
a favor and give any extra
Prize Medals you might have
to the Einbroch Factory, okay?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
我是说，我在这里待了这么久，却还没赢过任何比赛！
拜托你个忙，如果你有多余的神奇奖牌，
请把它们交给艾音布罗克工厂，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Absent Minded Man]
Say, are you here to bet
on the monster races? I've
come all the way here, just
because some strange man
asked me to win medals. It's
the only reason I'm in Hugel...
scripts.translation:
[心不在焉的男子]
喂，你是来赌怪物赛跑的吗？
我大老远来到这里，
只是因为一个奇怪的男子让我去赢奖牌。
这是我来到毁葛的唯一原因...

scripts.text:
[Absent Minded Man]
But I've made more than
100 wagers, and haven't won
any of them! I mean, if I bet
on the same monster 6 times,
I should win at least once,
right? What's going on?!
scripts.translation:
[心不在焉的男子]
但我已经下了100多注，却一注都没赢！
我是说，如果我连续6次押注同一只怪物，
我至少应该赢一次吧？到底怎么回事？！
